messages: Maya Chen: heads up — I opened a docs PR that needs approval before tomorrow's release cutoff. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 Jamal Patel: what's blocking? CI preview ok? Maya Chen: preview failing for versioned site build, error in frontmatter for v1.4. See log: DocsCI Bot: build failed -> 500: missing 'versions' entry DocsCI Bot: [automated] build failed for branch maya/docs/feat-embed-snippet — logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/12345 Tess H.: I can look. I think we changed the versioned sidebar key name. Quick fix: add this to the frontmatter: ``` versions: ["stable", "v1.4"] current_version: "v1.4" ``` Liam O'Connor: also FYI this PR includes an SDK snippet that references the new batch param — need docs and SDK to be in sync. If SDK release lags, we should gate docs behind feature flag. Maya Chen: good catch. We planned to enable ff:batching_opt in next deploy. Is release team ok with rolling docs after feature flag flip? Samira: Release team here — we can flip the FF during the canary at 05:00 UTC but cutoff for docs merge is 03:00 UTC to guarantee previews. If the PR isn't merged by 03:00 we risk mismatch. Jamal Patel: Can someone approve the content review? @Tess H. said she'll fix frontmatter. Who can be reviewer for wording and snippet accuracy? Tess H.: I'll push the frontmatter fix in a follow-up commit and tag Jamal for code snippet review. @Liam O'Connor can you confirm SDK compatibility? Liam O'Connor: Confirmed — the batch param will be available in SDK 0.9.2 which is scheduled to publish after the canary. If docs goes live before SDK, link will break. Suggest using feature flag in doc snippet: ```html client.generate({batch: true}) ``` Maya Chen: ok let's do gated snippet. I need an approver for merge by 02:30 UTC. @Jamal can you review then? Jamal Patel: I'll set a reminder and do a quick review at 02:15 UTC. If the CI passes after frontmatter fix, I'm good to approve. DocsCI Bot: [automated] preview available: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr/842 — build queued, expected ready in ~5m Maya Chen: thanks everyone. I'll post here when it's green. :thumbsup: DocsCI Bot: [automated] preview ready: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr/842/1 — smoke tests passed Jamal Patel: approved. Merge window cleared. :tada: ReleaseBot: Scheduled canary deploy at 05:00 UTC. Docs changes included are gated behind ff=batched_client — will only show when flag is active. Maya Chen: merging now. Will monitor preview post-merge for any regressions.
